title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Vellum

Vellum is on a mission to empower the (re)insurance industry to cover the risks of tomorrow. While many consumers have never heard of reinsurance - basically insurance for insurance companies - it is a $500+ billion industry that plays a crucial role in providing coverage for catastrophic events such as earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, and wildfires. At Vellum we are leveraging modern technology, advanced analytics, and machine learning to modernize and advance this industry that is burdened by technology and processes that have been largely unchanged in decades. Our team has deep experience in insurance and transforming antiquated technology in established industries.
How you will help
We are seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive revenue growth by continuing to introduce Vellum ’s data analytics platform to enterprise insurance and reinsurance customers. You will own the full sales cycle, develop strategic relationships with C-suite and technical buyers, and articulate how Vellum ’s AI-enabled solution delivers transformative value across underwriting, actuarial, operations, and portfolio management.
As a key revenue driver at this insurtech, you will influence product strategy through customer insights, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and help define go-to-market excellence. Specifically, you will:
Sales & Revenue Growth

• Develop pipeline within target accounts by combining outbound prospecting, warm introductions through Vellum ’s network, and in-person field events.

• Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting to close with carriers, reinsurers, and large MGAs/MGUs.

• Qualify opportunities, build reliable forecasts, and exceed quarterly and annual quotas.

• Lead discovery calls, demos, solution positioning, and executive presentations.

Strategic Customer Engagement

• Build trusted advisor relationships with decision-makers (eg., CEO, CUO, CFO).

• Understand customer data challenges and map Vellum ’s platform to solve real business outcomes (eg., data transparency, underwriting profitability, efficiency).

Go-To-Market Execution

• Partner closely with Data, Technology, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to optimize messaging, refine case studies, and tailor solutions to customer needs.

• Create compelling proposals and commercial agreements that reflect customer value and business impact.

Market Intelligence

• Develop deep expertise in the insurance and reinsurance ecosystem, including underwriting workflows, actuarial analytics, portfolio risk management, and data governance.

• Gather competitive insights and communicate market feedback back to internal product partners.

• Advise the leadership team on the strategic direction of go-to-market efforts.
About You

• 12+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience selling SaaS, analytics, data platforms, or enterprise technology (preferably into insurance, reinsurance, financial services or related sectors).

• Strong understanding of the insurance and reinsurance value chain, including risk analytics, underwriting, portfolio reporting, bordereau, actuarial needs, and how data challenges impact decision-making.

• Experience drafting and leading presentations with prospective and current clients leveraging Excel, Powerpoint, and other communication tools.

• Trusted advisor skillset with the ability to influence C-level executives and technical stakeholders.

• Comfortable discussing data workflows, cloud-native analytics, AI/ML-enabled platforms, and integration considerations.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.

• Comfortable with regular travel to engage enterprise clients in-person and represent the company at key market events and conferences.

Benefits

• As an early stage company, Vellum provides tremendous opportunity for growth both in terms of equity and career development

• Competitive compensation packages

• 401k Match

Job Summary:
Engaging UX/UI Designers to participate in a dynamic project focused on video annotation for advanced robotic arm tasks.

• Review video footage of robotic arms completing specific tasks and annotate sessions as instructed.

• Apply detailed, accurate tags and grading based on provided guidelines and project requirements.

• Utilize video annotation tools to mark key actions, behaviors, and outcomes within each session.

• Document observations and rationales clearly and concisely for each annotated task.

• Collaborate with project trainers and fellow contributors to ensure consistency and quality across annotations.

• Provide feedback to enhance labeling guidelines and annotation processes as the project evolves.

• Meet project deliverables by organizing and submitting completed annotations within requested timeframes.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in UX/UI design, web design, video/music editing, photography, filmmaking, audiovisual production, robotics, or engineering (mechanical/electronics).

• Proven experience with video annotation or data labeling, ideally for AI training or machine learning purposes.

• Exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of producing high-quality, precise work.

• Strong written communication skills for clear documentation and collaboration.

• Familiarity with video annotation tools and digital content review workflows.

• Experience in collaborative project environments and comfort working with remote teams.

• Interest in robotics, advanced technologies, or AI-driven projects is a strong plus.

A very attractive and competitive package is offered.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.
Position Overview/Mandate:
The Project Manager plays a key role in planning, coordinating, and delivering complex development projects for Fidus clients, from initial scope through to final delivery. You will work directly with customers, Sales, and Fidus's technical teams to manage project scope, schedule, and budget, and to keep everyone aligned as the project moves from design through implementation.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on project diversity, enjoys building strong relationships across technical and business teams, and takes pride in delivering projects on time, on budget, and to a high standard.
Make an Impact with Us:
At Fidus, you'll lead high-speed, high-complexity electronic system projects, often built on emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll coordinate cross-functional teams spanning FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our clients.
In practice, that means managing projects in areas such as space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video, imaging, VR/AR applications, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. You won't be limited to a single product or industry - your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Plan, deliver, and manage multiple concurrent projects ranging in size from medium to large

• Coordinate project teams that may be distributed across multiple location sites and disciplines

• Forge strong partnerships with Sales, the Customer, and the Project Team to ensure efficiency across all aspects of the project

• Work closely with Sales and Technical Leads to understand project requirements

• Take independent ownership of project decisions related to scope, schedule, and budget

• Regularly update customers and internal management on project status via meetings and/or reports

• Manage project process and resources, including budget and schedules, from design and development through implementation

• Identify process gaps and implement process improvements at the project level

• Manage technical negotiations with suppliers

Who You Are:

• Minimum of five (5) years of relevant technical industry experience, including at least three (3) years of Project Management experience

• University degree or equivalent

• Proven track record managing large projects using project management methodologies

• Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

• Demonstrated delivery of innovative solutions to project challenges

• Experience using project management tracking software, such as Microsoft Project

• Completed or working towards PMP is an asset

• Completion of an Engineering degree and previous technical engineering experience is an asset

Location and travel: Fully remote role and travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Replication Foundations
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join the Replication Foundations team within Temporal’s Cloud Global Services (CGS) organization.

Replication Foundations owns and evolves Temporal’s core replication stack in Temporal OSS-the distributed systems backbone behind key Temporal Cloud capabilities such as High Availability namespaces, cross-cluster and cross-region failover, and migration products that enable customers to move workloads between self-hosted Temporal and Temporal Cloud. The team also builds foundational scalability and reliability mechanisms that support Temporal at scale.

In this role, you’ll help set the technical direction for Temporal’s distributed replication systems. You’ll lead complex, correctness-critical initiatives spanning architecture, design, implementation, rollout, and operations. You’ll work across teams to evolve reliable and scalable replication capabilities that support both the open source project and Temporal Cloud.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Set the technical direction and evolve the architecture of Temporal’s OSS replication stack, from problem definition through rollout and operational support.

- Lead the design and implementation of replication protocols that power:

- High Availability namespaces

- Cross-cluster and cross-region replication

- Migration between Temporal clusters, including cloud-to-self-hosted and cloud-to-cloud scenarios

- Drive scalability and reliability initiatives such as:

- Multi-cell namespaces

- Enabling a namespace to span multiple clusters

- Improving load distribution and handling hot spots

- Define and communicate system-level guarantees, including consistency models, ordering, idempotency, failure recovery, performance, and operational behavior.

- Identify architectural risks and opportunities, and shape the technical roadmap for replication capabilities that support current and future cloud products.

- Partner with Cloud Enablement, CGS, Product, and other engineering teams to align OSS replication foundations with customer and product needs.

- Lead design reviews, raise the quality of implementation and testing practices, mentor engineers, and provide technical guidance across the organization.

- Lead or contribute to debugging complex production issues, incident response, and follow-up improvements related to replication and core system behavior.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- A track record of designing and delivering complex production distributed systems, including systems where correctness, availability, and performance are critical.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals such as replication, partitioning, consistency, fault tolerance, durability, concurrency, and failure recovery.

- Experience defining system architecture, protocol behavior, invariants, and trade-offs in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

- Experience debugging complex production issues, including concurrency bugs, data inconsistencies, partial failures, and performance bottlenecks.

- Proficiency writing production-quality concurrent code in Go; experience with Java, C++, or similar systems languages is also welcome.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex designs and trade-offs to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, build alignment without direct authority, and mentor engineers.

- A thoughtful and curious approach to understanding how systems behave under load, failure, and changing workload conditions.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience designing or maintaining replication protocols or data-plane infrastructure.

- Experience with multi-cluster or multi-region architectures, including active-active or active-passive systems.

- Familiarity with database internals, log-based replication, or event-sourced systems.

- Prior contributions to large open source projects or distributed systems infrastructure.

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

- You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

- You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

- You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

- Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

- Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

- Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Global Defense (GD) team is responsible for establishing and expanding Anduril's international business, developing and delivering the products and technology that address the unique security challenges faced by America's Allies and partners. The team operates across every major theater, pairing deep regional expertise with a sophisticated command of foreign military sales, trade, and compliance frameworks.

GD team members serve as the bridge between international customers and the broader Anduril enterprise; they translate partner-nation requirements and perspectives back to Anduril's Business Lines, while serving as Anduril's ambassadors and partners abroad. They shape and capture new opportunities by leveraging Anduril's strengths in innovation, modern warfighting, agile foreign sales strategies, and rigorous export compliance. The team's work spans the full lifecycle of international engagement: global strategy and market analysis; international business development and deal navigation; partnerships and representation; trade, export control, and Tech Security & Foreign Disclosure (TSFD); and the global operations, security, and in-country presence required to execute.

• Navigate FMS and direct commercial sales pathways. Work with Trade Compliance, Technology Security & Foreign Disclosure, and US government stakeholders (including AIT and DSCA) to structure and advance opportunities across FMS and DCS channels.

• Build partnerships and localization. Develop teaming and industrial partnerships with Taiwan industry to support local production, sustainment, and resilience.

• Inform product development. Translate Taiwan's operational requirements back to Business Lines and engineering, and ensure delivery teams have the context to succeed.

• 15+ years of industry, government, or military experience, including senior business development or program leadership in the Taiwan defense market

• Fluency in Mandarin and English

• Experience leading or building an in-market team

• Experience with complex systems involving hardware and software

• Familiarity with enterprise AI and autonomous systems a plus

• Comfortable setting and achieving goals in a complex, ambiguous environment

• STEM degree a plus

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

 
E-Space is building the infrastructure for a new generation of space operations. As we scale to the next stage of growth over the next 18 months, we need someone to programmatize how we communicate internally and deliberately build culture that sustains retention and belonging. 
This is a builder role: you'll take what exists and create the infrastructure, cadences, and editorial strategy that make E-Space feel like a coherent company where people understand the mission, where their work connects to it, and where they genuinely want to show up. 
You'll balance two equally important missions: (1) owning the systems and channels that keep E-Space informed and aligned as we scale, and (2) collaborating with the People team to build intentional culture programs, celebrations, and spaces that make work feel meaningful and connected. You'll do this in an environment where the exec leadership, People team, and cross-functional partners all have competingasks, a level of ambiguity, and high expectations, and where the guardrails aren't yet clear. You'll need to be comfortable making calls about what gets done, in what order, and what doesn't, without waiting for permission. 
It’s important to note that this role is internally facing because the company is currently in Stealth Mode as we build our world-class technology, so this role will not include any aspect of external comms or PR.  
This role will nominally report to the Head of People but will operate as a shared service bridging the executive leadership team and the broader company. The successful candidate will be required to work onsite to collaborate with team members in our Arlington, TX offices.

The role sits at the intersection of exec visibility, people operations, and culture. You'll have direct access to the CEO and leadership team, close partnership with People, and real agency to shape how the company communicates with itself as we scale. 

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference

About EnCharge AI

EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in-memory-computing architecture delivers a 10x step-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon & systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation.
The Opportunity
We serve open-weight models and our own bespoke checkpoints on EnCharge hardware. The models change often, and the harness around them needs to keep up. You own this layer that runs agents against files, tools, documents with permissions, memory, unattended execution, and real outputs. It will be assembled from a combination of open-source and bespoke code.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the harness architecture end to end - agent loop, safe execution, context management, knowledge base, memory, permissions, orchestration, outputs, interfaces, observability - one component per layer, with clear interfaces so layers can be swapped.

• Build the pieces with no open-source equivalent e.g. session semantics, enforced permissions, memory in a human-editable file, orchestrator, and outputs.

• Keep pace with the models: adapters, prompt formats, tool-call schemas, stop conditions, benchmarking and evaluation.

• Make tool use reliable across models of uneven tool-calling quality - validation, repair, retries, fallbacks.

Management Simulation Workshop Facilitator

WITTIGONIA Dynamics is the system dynamics and modelling practice of WITTIGONIA , delivering quantitative management simulation workshops for leadership teams, strategy groups, and organisational learning programmes globally.
You are an experienced system dynamics practitioner who brings both modelling depth and facilitation skill to the room. In this freelance, contract-based role , you guide participant teams through rigorous, data-grounded simulation experiences - connecting model behaviour, feedback dynamics, and scenario outcomes to real-world management decisions. You work primarily in online and virtual formats , with in-person engagements possible depending on client needs.
You will join our growing facilitator pool, beginning with co-facilitation alongside a senior WITTIGONIA Dynamics lead and progressing toward independent delivery. Candidates new to workshop facilitation are welcome to enquire about our co-facilitator entry pathway - we are building a community of practice and will be announcing structured onboarding formats, including bootcamp and summer school programmes, in due course.

• You facilitate online management simulation workshops across the WITTIGONIA Dynamics portfolio - including our custom business dynamics models (Vensim, Stella Architect, Ventity, AnyLogic), pre-built simulations from Forio , and calibrated climate scenario tools from Climate Interactive (En-ROADS, C-ROADS)

• You guide participant teams through structured scenario decision-making rounds, connecting stock-and-flow behaviour, feedback loop dynamics, and simulation outputs to strategic management insights

• You join a growing global facilitator pool of system dynamics practitioners, with opportunities to deliver workshops across industries and geographies

• You operate on a remote-first, online delivery basis with the flexibility of a freelance contract - in-person engagements are possible and may grow as client demand evolves

• You develop your facilitation practice through structured co-facilitation onboarding , progressing toward independent lead facilitator status within the WITTIGONIA Dynamics portfolio

• You gain access to continuous professional development in system dynamics facilitation, quantitative model analysis, and simulation-based workshop design

• You will have early access to structured community-building initiatives we are developing - including bootcamp and summer school formats - as we build a practitioner community around management simula

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Communications/Media Intern - Citizens Against Government Waste
tags: Part Time or Full Time Internship
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
 
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

Tes tâches :

- Soutenir l’équipe en produisant des extrants non pixellisés conformément aux spécifications des médias.

- Assurer l’uniformité de la marque et respecter les normes de grande qualité de l’entreprise.

- Jouer un rôle essentiel en aidant à communiquer visuellement notre produit à de multiples publics.

- Concevoir, adapter et produire des documents de marketing et de vente, y compris des présentations, des communications internes et des outils de vente.

- Proposer des solutions créatives qui soutiennent la marque et les objectifs d’affaires sur toutes les plateformes, de la présentation à la production finale.

- Contribuer et collaborer avec l’équipe élargie composée de concepteurs, de spécialistes du marketing de produits, de rédacteurs de contenu et de directeurs du marketing.

- Gérer et respecter tes propres échéances de projet en tenant compte des commentaires et des directives du ou de la gestionnaire de projet.

Ce que tu dois apporter :

- Un portfolio mettant en valeur ta créativité, tes compétences en conception visuelle et la qualité de ton travail.

- Maîtrise de Figma et de la suite Adobe Creative.

- Au moins 1 an d’expérience en conception graphique multidisciplinaire dans un domaine connexe, en mettant l’accent sur le design numérique.

- Une capacité à concilier pensée créative et résultats axés sur la performance.

- Un souci du détail et le désir de perfectionner et d’élever continuellement ton travail.

- De solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps, y compris la capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches et de livrer un travail de qualité dans des délais serrés.

- Une passion pour le design, une curiosité pour les tendances émergentes et le désir d’apprendre continuellement et de perfectionner ton métier.

- En tant qu’entreprise mondiale comptant des employés et des clients à l’extérieur du Québec, la maîtrise de l’anglais comme langue de travail est requise pour ce poste.

Nous savons qu’une personne ne se résume pas à son CV. Si tu ne sais pas si ton profil convient au poste, clique sur le bouton « Postuler » pour le découvrir!

Tu pourras profiter :

- D’un milieu de travail flexible qui te permet de donner le meilleur de toi-même.

- D’une culture qui valorise la performance.

- De la possibilité d’avoir un impact au sein d’une équipe assez grande pour progresser au niveau professionnel, mais suffisamment petite pour te faire entendre.

Tu profiteras également d’avantages visant à te procurer bonheur, santé et satisfaction.

- Politiques flexibles sur les congés payés et le télétravail.
